notes.title: Elder Sign: Omens compatibility update!
notes.notes:
We have updated Elder Sign: Omens to support 64-bit iOS devices in anticipation of iOS 11! Our Steam build has been optimized to reflect changes made to the mobile versions.

Thank you for your support and feedback!
